ABINAYA R
Business Analyst | Data Governance | Regulatory Reporting | Data Steward 
abinayaravi9865@gmail.com | 9787433002 | linkedin.com/in/abinaya
raw_sections.summary:
SUMMARY
Business Analyst with 4+ years of experience in Enterprise Data Governance supporting Global Banking and Investment Banking initiatives. Experienced in collaborating with Legal, Risk, Compliance, Finance, Product Owners, Data Owners, Data Stewards, and Technology stakeholders to deliver metadata management, business glossary, data lineage, Critical Data Elements (CDE), regulatory reporting, and audit readiness solutions.
raw_sections.experience:
WORK EXPERIENCE
Mu Sigma Business Solutions Pvt Ltd
Project Manager – Enterprise level Transformation Initiative	Feb 2026 – Present
Lead enterprise transformation initiatives in partnership with executive leadership, driving organizational culture, employee experience, change management, and operational excellence programs
Manage end-to-end program delivery including strategic planning, stakeholder management, governance, risk management, and executive reporting across multiple business functions
Partner with C-level stakeholders to translate business objectives into measurable initiatives, ensuring cross-functional alignment and successful execution
Govern 20+ project deliverables, milestones, dependencies, and executive reports, ensuring alignment between business and technology teams
Manage project roadmaps, Agile ceremonies, leadership dashboards, and governance forums to support decision-making and program success
Drive governance frameworks, performance tracking, and continuous improvement initiatives to achieve strategic business outcomes
Mu Sigma Business Solutions Pvt Ltd
Data Steward – Leading Global Financial Institution (Client: Citi Bank – Global Banking & Investment Banking)		Jan 2022 - Jan 2026
Supported Enterprise Data Governance initiatives across Retail Cards, Risk Management, and Regulatory Reporting domains by partnering with Business, Legal, Risk, Compliance, Finance, Data Owners, Data Stewards, and Technology stakeholders to strengthen governance frameworks and regulatory compliance.
Managed Data Lineage, Metadata Management, Data Stewardship, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Risk Assessment Questionnaires (RAQ), and Critical Data Element (CDE) governance activities to improve data controls, transparency, and enterprise data quality.
Partnered with Legal, Risk, Compliance, Business SMEs, Data Owners, and Data Stewards to define Critical Data Elements (CDEs), data ownership, business glossary, metadata standards, regulatory classifications, and governance controls supporting enterprise-wide regulatory reporting and audit readiness.
Resolved 100+ critical data quality issues impacting regulatory reporting through root cause analysis, remediation tracking, issue prioritization, and governance oversight.
Implemented Data Quality frameworks, validation rules, governance controls, and monitoring processes to improve data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and integrity across critical banking data assets.
Performed data profiling, metadata validation, source-to-target mapping, and control monitoring to support regulatory compliance, issue remediation, and continuous data quality improvement.
Developed and maintained end-to-end data lineage, metadata documentation, source-to-target mappings, business definitions, and governance artefacts to support regulatory reporting, audit readiness, risk management, and impact analysis.
Developed data quality dashboards, governance scorecards, KPI reports, and executive MIS to monitor data quality, remediation progress, governance metrics, and regulatory compliance.
Collaborated with Product Owners, Business SMEs, Legal, Risk, Compliance, Finance, Data Owners, Data Stewards, and Technology teams to gather business requirements, prepare governance documentation, and translate regulatory requirements into enterprise data governance solutions.
Managed metadata, business glossary, data lineage, and data catalog activities using Collibra, improving enterprise data traceability, metadata quality, and governance maturity.
Supported User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by validating business rules, verifying data quality, and ensuring governance requirements were successfully implemented before production deployment.
raw_sections.skills:
SKILLS
Core Competencies: Data Governance, Data Stewardship, Regulatory Reporting (FR Y-14M, FR Y-14Q, Basel), Data Quality Management, Critical Data Elements (CDE), Data Lineage, Metadata Management, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Data Controls, Regulatory Compliance, Risk Management, Audit Readiness, BCBS 239, Data Governance Framework
Business Analysis & Analytics: Business Analysis, Requirement Gathering, BRD/FRD, Process Mapping, Gap Analysis, Stakeholder Management, UAT, Data Analysis, Reporting, Project Governance SQL, Advanced Excel, Power BI
Tools & Technologies: Collibra, JIRA, Azure, Power Automate, Confluence, ALM, SharePoint, Agile/Scrum, Ab Initio, IBM Blueworks
ADDITIONAL CONTRIBUTIONS
Led an internal process audit team of 10+ members to enforce SOP compliance and ensure completeness and accuracy of project documentation
Partnered with senior leadership to identify client challenges and design targeted business proposals, contributing to organizational expansion
Designed and delivered comprehensive onboarding programs for 10+ new project hires, covering technical training through client introduction and operational readiness
raw_sections.awards:
AWARDS AND RECOGNITION
Received 3 Spot Awards for exceptional work ethics, taking initiative in project delivery, leading teams successfully, and consistently exceeding expectations in multiple projects
Developed training programs and mentored 50+ new hires on data analytics, problem-solving, and coding at Mu Sigma
Recognized by the client for maintaining detailed documentation and serving as the primary point of contact for project-related activities, ensuring smooth coordination and communication
